en: A vintage colored postcard showing a large military barracks complex with multi‑storey buildings with red-tiled roofs surrounding an open yard lined with young trees. A row of uniformed soldiers stands in formation along one of the buildings. The front side bears the printed caption "Pécs — Frigyes főherceg laktanya". The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text, a red 10 fillér Hungarian postage stamp with a postmark, sender and recipient addresses, and divided sections for correspondence and address.
